dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Progressive, symmetrical narrowing of the body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior terminus within the field of view.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white dorsal skin tone, partially affected by brownish water turbidity at the peripheral margins.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Subtle, low-frequency grey mottling distributed across the posterior dorsal and lateral surfaces.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the primary light dorsal surface and the darker lateral-posterior regions.

other_distinctive_markers: Centrally located, dark elliptical blowhole aperture on the anterior dorsal surface, surrounded by bright specular highlights.
